qa_pairs.question: What is the primary function of the "Account statistics" section within the Metrix portal for Alliance users?
qa_pairs.answer: The "Account statistics" section in the Metrix portal is designed to display a group's resource usage, organized into two distinct subsections: CPU and GPU.

qa_pairs.question: What types of information are available for tracking under the "CPU accounts" subsection of the Metrix portal's "Account statistics" section?
qa_pairs.answer: Under the "CPU accounts" subsection, users can track their group's total CPU core requests and usage over the past few months, monitor their priority status, see the most frequently used CPU applications, view resource usage and wasted CPU cores and memory by each user in their group, and observe filesystem activity, including input/output operations per second (IOPS) and bandwidth, as well as the last jobs run by all group members.

qa_pairs.question: What types of information are available for tracking under the "GPU accounts" subsection of the Metrix portal's "Account statistics" section?
qa_pairs.answer: Under the "GPU accounts" subsection, users can see their group's total GPU requests and usage over the past few months, track their priority status, identify the most frequently used software, view resources used and wasted GPUs, CPU cores, and memory by each user in their group, and monitor filesystem activity, including input/output operations per second (IOPS) and bandwidth, as well as the last jobs run by their group.
